unary_unary_rpc: handle a unary-unary gRPC RPC by extracting invocation metadata and request from channel state
unary_stream_rpc: handle a unary-stream gRPC RPC by extracting request and returning a streamable response object
stream_unary_rpc: handle a stream-unary gRPC RPC by extracting invocation metadata and accepting streamed requests
stream_stream_rpc: handle a stream-stream gRPC RPC by extracting metadata and managing bidirectional streaming
terminate_rpc_response: terminate a gRPC RPC with a response, trailing metadata, status code, and details
